subject: Investor summary orchestration + Q2 OKR highlights

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>

Subject: Investor summary orchestration + Q2 OKR highlights

Team — attaching a first-pass investor-facing summary slide set and the OKR appendix for Q2. This is intended for the board packet and the investor update I’ll share with Horizon (Samantha) next week. Requests and constraints below: 

- Ask: please review the deck and OKR appendix and send edits by EOD tomorrow (May 4). We need a consolidated file by 3pm PT so legal can route to DocuSign for the board acknowledgement.
- Specifics: highlight any material changes in revenue guidance, runway, or critical hires on the first two slides. Add a one-line risk callout for any slide where progress is behind plan.
- Ownership: Marcus — numbers & revenue slide; Jonas — GTM roadmap condensed to one slide for the investor view; Lauren — people/hiring paragraph for the appendix. I’ll keep overall narrative and investor notes.

Attachments: 20270503-investor-summary-slide-v1.pptx (draft), OKR-appendix-2027Q2.xlsx

Thanks — short, focused edits appreciated.

—Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
VP, Strategy & Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 11:03:12 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor summary orchestration + Q2 OKR highlights

Eve — quick pass attached (metrics-appendix.csv) and inline notes below. High-level: revenue pacing is fine but we should be explicit about the ARR definition and remove the two-month projection chart (confuses the board). Suggested swaps: move the runway slide after the OKR highlights, and put ARR reconciliation in the appendix.

Inline:
- Slide 3 (revenue): call out net new ARR and churn separately.
- Slide 5 (bookings): add $ value for the top three deals.
- Risk callout: change the tone to "monitoring" for the integration slippage — avoid alarmist language unless we have a material impact.

I'll push numbers to the shared sheet and attach the CSV with the latest extracts.

Marcus
Director, Finance | Redwood Inference
Attachments: metrics-appendix.csv
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 13:20:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Investor summary orchestration + Q2 OKR highlights

Thanks Marcus — good calls.

Jonas — please condense the GTM roadmap to one slide and keep only top-3 milestones for the quarter (customer wins, product launches, partnerships). Avoid a 6-month timeline; investors want clarity on immediate cadence.

Lauren — can you draft a 3-4 sentence "people & hiring" section for the appendix that covers: open roles prioritized for Q2, ramp timing for the leadership hires, and a one-line note about the candidate pipeline velocity? Put that text into the OKR appendix tab called "People".

I’ll reconcile the narrative and push a consolidated v2 by late afternoon.

—Evelyn

- I shortened the product milestones to three bullets and added a 1-line customer momentum proof point.
- Slide 8 now reads: "Hiring ask: flexibility to accelerate two key roles pending M1 results."

Eve — draft people blurb below (put into "People" tab in the appendix):

"Hiring & org: Prioritized hires for Q2 include Head of Product Marketing and two Staff ML Engineers (platform). We expect the Head of PM to start by 2027-08; engineering hires are staged with offers in late June and start dates in July/Aug. Candidate pipeline remains steady — we have 4 active finalists for the Head of PM role. We will request board approval to accelerate two leadership hires if M1 metrics are achieved by end of Q2."

Small edit: change "leadership hires" to "leadership role accelerations" on slide 8.
